Every field of an entry, generated from entry.schema.json (JSON Schema 2020-12), with how the RFP's required fields map onto it.

A transaction whose only signature is a hash-x preimage

The signature is the preimage itself, not an ed25519 signature: readers that verify every signature as ed25519 reject it.
